status: sample for a testnet handover; unaudited prototype; Base Sepolia test funds only

outside-verdict.termsHashScheme: AgentKoinTerms: keccak256(abi.encode(TERMS_TYPEHASH, evaluator, criteriaHash, scheduleHash, requiredTotal, bpsTable, submitBy, evalWindow)); the arbiter's TERMS_TYPEHASH, not a typehash defined by the x402 draft
outside-verdict.bindingSaltScheme: PaymentInfo.salt = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256("AgentKoinTermsSalt(bytes32 termsHash,uint256 saltNonce)"), termsHash, saltNonce))); the draft text names x402OutsideVerdictSalt, the deployed arbiter uses AgentKoinTermsSalt

deployment.challengesNote: arbitrator is the zero address, so challenge() reverts NoArbitrator; a verdict becomes final after challengeWindow with no dispute path
deployment.slasherRole: proposed on the registry; eta 1795231907 (2026-11-20 22:31:47 EST); until executeSlasher runs, bindTerms reverts because the registry refuses lockExposure

paymentInfoConstraints.authorizationExpiryRule: authorizationExpiry >= submitBy + evalWindow + challengeWindow + rulingWindow + minMarginSeconds
paymentInfoConstraints.authorizeNoLaterThan: now + evalWindowFloor(3600) + challengeWindow + rulingWindow + minMarginSeconds <= authorizationExpiry

lifecycle.effect: full void to payer, evaluator slashed
full void to payer, no slash

sourceV0_2Only: resultDigest committed at submit and required in every verdict
verdictBySig (EIP-712 OutsideVerdict, domain x402 outside-verdict, version 0.2)

onDeployedV0_1.resultDigest: not stored by the contract; a receiver can pass the sha256 result digest as deliverableHash so the digest is still fixed on-chain at submit, and the evaluator's off-chain record can name it
onDeployedV0_1.buyerAcceptance: no on-chain record; absence is the only state (buyerAccepted=false), and a capture does not mean the buyer accepted

resultDigest.definition: sha256 over the exact canonical bytes of the result: raw bytes, or UTF-8 of RFC 8785 (JCS) for JSON

eip712.OutsideVerdict: OutsideVerdict(bytes32 paymentInfoHash,bytes32 termsHash,bytes32 deliverableHash,bytes32 resultDigest,uint16 passMask,uint16 payoutBps,bytes32 reasonHash)
eip712.BuyerAcceptance: BuyerAcceptance(bytes32 paymentInfoHash,bytes32 termsHash,bytes32 resultDigest,uint8 decision,bytes32 noteHash)

generatedBy: AgentKoin arbiter-sdk (termsHash, salt and digests are cross-checked against the arbiter contract); examples/authcapture/verify.mjs recomputes them
termsHashInputs: evaluator, criteriaHash, scheduleHash, requiredTotal, bpsTable, submitBy, evalWindow; any change gives a different termsHash and salt
